description: Every recorded change across Kingy's datasets since a date: API price and spec changes, usage-limit and plan changes, new or updated shutdowns and retirement deadlines, new launches, and reviewed retirements or breaking changes. Each event has before/after values, the Kingy page and the official source. Use it to catch up or to poll.

datasets.description: Limit to these datasets. Default all.

include_verification_states.description: Also return price verification state flips (current/held). Default false.

since.description: Date (UTC), e.g. 2026-11-01. Events on or after this date.

name: what_changed_since
title: What changed since a date
